neighbours.label: 'just' meaning merely, playing something down ('it's just talking heads', 'is just an ideal')
fire: You can ignore the sequel because it's just people shouting.
Don't worry about the rumor, since it's just gossip.
For most of them, retirement is just a dream they will never reach.
The whole debate is just noise, if you ask me.
You can skip the last chapter since it's just footnotes.
To my boss, the safety rule is just a slogan on a wall.
In the end, that promise was just talk from a tired man.
Stop worrying about the mark, because it's just a scratch.
quiet: You can ignore the sequel because it's very long.
He has just arrived from the airport with his bags.
For most of them, retirement has just begun this year.
The whole debate just ended, if you ask me.
You can skip the last chapter since it's very dry.
My boss had just put the safety rule on a wall.
In the end, that man was just about to leave for home.
Stop worrying about the mark, because I just cleaned it.

notes: Card: ' only' x8, ' just' x6, '中', ' others', ' qu'. Probe: 'it's just talking heads' 0.72, 'is just an ideal' 0.33; 'has just arrived' 0.03, 'only five dollars' 0.03, 'it was only a reflection' 0.04, so ' only' is not claimed here.
